We need to find mapped_rxn and template_id for sulfonamide formation retrosynthetic step. We have target molecule? Not given directly. The previous task make_7_lvl2-apply_template-2 asked: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_7_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below?" Answer was [] meaning no precursors found. So maybe the template search didn't find any applicable template? We need to return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below, reproduces the reaction. We need the molecule SMILES. Not provided in prompt. Might be in prior context but not given. Could be that the molecule is a sulfonamide product. We need to search template catalog for sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken? In forward reaction, sulfonyl chloride (R-S(=O)2-Cl) reacts with amine (R'-NH2) to form sulfonamide (R-S(=O)2-NHR') and HCl. So bonds formed: S-N bond. Bonds broken: S-Cl bond. Functional groups formed: sulfonamide. Broken: sulfonyl chloride? functional group broken maybe "sulfonyl_chloride"? Not sure list. Could just search with bonds_formed ["S-N"]? But format expects "X-Y" where numbers are atomic numbers? Example "6-6" for C-C. So S is atomic number 16, N is 7. So bond formed "16-7". Bond broken "16-17" (Cl atomic number 17). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with bonds_formed=["16-7"], bonds_broken=["16-17"], limit 5.
